description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 24.07.2023 to 30.07.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that establishes new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and rescinds a previous notification, making it a legal/regulatory instrument rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized type.
